info.description:
Where a principal holds the reins of its subjects: which
subjects an account at the door may look into and take up.
A principal first seen is given two personas in `subjects`.
Who holds each subject's reins now (the one wheel): taken
from a device, handed to a brain, given back.
Reached only through the door (X-Principal-Id). Own database
on its own network. The routes tagged inner are on the inner
port (INTERNAL_PORT, 8088), for drivers, never forwarded by the door.
info.title: Reins

get.description:
Answers if the process is serving HTTP at all, and says nothing
about Postgres or subjects; scripts/stack_version.py reads the version.

On reins' inner port (INTERNAL_PORT), never forwarded by the
door: no principal. A driver reads it at boot and on each
reins.hold.changed, and keeps those of its own profiles.
get.summary: Every hold of a brain (inner port)

post.description:
On reins' inner port, never forwarded by the door. The driver
whose reply failed lets go: nobody holds the subject when
brain:<profile> still does, the avatar is offline, and
reins.hold.changed says so with holder "". When someone else
holds it now, nothing changes (released false): a late letting
go never drops another holder. Re-attaching is a steward's.
post.summary: A brain lets go of its own hold (inner port)

get.description:
Server-sent events. `ready` first, its id the position the stream
starts after. `entry`: one appended entry (threads' shape) of a
thread one of the caller's avatars is in, read back from threads
on its event; its id is the event's id on threads_events, so a
reconnect with Last-Event-ID (or since=) resumes after it.
`writing`: a piece of a reply still being written there (never
journaled, no id). `reset`: the position is no longer on the
stream; reload what is shown.
get.summary: Follow the threads the caller's avatars are in

get.description:
The subjects whose reins the principal in X-Principal-Id holds,
read from `subjects` (deleted ones left out), oldest first. The
first call for a principal makes what is missing of its two
personas: nick `<login>` and
`<login>-assistant`, names empty. A nick taken by
another subject is never adopted. Each with its
current_brain as the caller sees it from X-Device-Id.

(a join entry sent by that avatar). Every one of them is an
avatar the caller steers: inviting another's is a later task.
Opening is an act of `as`: the caller holds its reins from
X-Device-Id, else 409.

patch.description:
A field left out is kept. Preferences are merged key by key
into the stored ones: a key given replaces it, a key given as
null takes it out, the rest are kept. Written to `subjects`
whole (its PUT), the nick and every other field as stored. The
nick is not in the body: it never changes, and a body naming
it, or any field but these three, is refused.

post.description:
The caller holds the subject from the device it names
(X-Device-Id): what it writes as that avatar is its. Any
steward may, from whoever holds it now (a brain, another
steward, another device); the former holder learns it on its
stream. The hold lapses when the device's stream has been gone
longer than HOLD_GRACE. The subject's current_brain as the caller sees it.
post.summary: Take the reins of a subject, from this device

delete.description:
The thread, its entries and its children, as threads deletes
them: out of the world, for everyone in it. Whoever sees the
thread may (one of the caller's avatars is a member); no reins
are needed and nobody is told. What points at it from elsewhere
(an attachment's url, a memory of it) is left pointing at nothing.

patch.description:
An update entry sent by `as`, carrying the new name: an act in
the thread like saying something, seen by everyone in it. `as`
must be an avatar the caller steers, whose reins it holds from
X-Device-Id (else 409), and a member of the thread. The name is
trimmed, 1 to 200 characters. The entry as threads stored it.

post.description:
An action on the brain: published as reins.reply.stop, and the
driver writing as the subject there cancels its run. What it
wrote so far is journaled as said when there is any text;
nothing when there is none. A steward of the subject may.

current_brain.description:
CurrentBrain is who holds its reins now, as the principal asking sees
it from its device: reins' own, added to what `subjects` sent, never
written there and never shown to a character.
